why: Drops the half of the gate that is about the SESSION rather than the ending. The sandbox ends as a `practice-result` (it is a practice-kind session) and runs one synthetic level, which is exactly the case for which `setLevelSelect`'s `unlocked > 1` already hides the Main Menu's own entry into the same pane (it was `total > 1` until issue #555) -- so this offers a button whose click leaves the session and lands on a menu with nothing behind it. It also silently drops the live half: `setLevelSelect` is pushed while the panel is up, and with the term gone there is nothing for that push to change.
